description: This Java source file defines the EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator class, an Akka actor responsible for orchestrating the cleanup of old event snapshots and related entities, reporting status, and handling messaging within a distributed system for persistence cleanup.

classes.name: EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for orchestrating the cleanup of event snapshots, managing status reports, and handling cleanup workflows in a distributed system environment.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Props configuration object to instantiate the EventSnapshotCleanupCoordinator actor with provided configuration, pub-sub mediator, and shard regions.

methods.name: preEnhanceStreamingBehavior
methods.description: Defines how the actor handles specific message types during streaming, enqueueing credit decisions and cleanup responses into internal logs.

methods.name: parseConfig
methods.description: Parses the provided Akka Config object into a PersistenceCleanupConfig instance.

methods.name: getEntityIdWithRevisionSource
methods.description: Constructs a source emitting EntityIdWithRevision objects by combining persistence ID source and credit source via a transistor.

methods.name: creditSource
methods.description: Creates a source emitting credit decision integers, derived from the credit decision source and self-reporting flow.

methods.name: persistenceIdSource
methods.description: Creates a source emitting EntityIdWithRevision objects from persistence ID source.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Provides the main source stream of cleanup responses by querying shard regions for entities to clean up, based on entity ID types.

methods.name: askShardRegionForCleanup
methods.description: Sends a cleanup request to a shard region actor for a given entity ID and handles the asynchronous response, including error handling.

methods.name: postEnhanceStatusReport
methods.description: Adds details to the status report JSON, including credit decisions and cleanup actions.
